scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sonara/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @sonara/api" "npm run dev -w @sonara/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sonara/contracts && npm run build -w @sonara/api && npm run build -w @sonara/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sonara/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sonara/api && npm run typecheck -w @sonara/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sonara/api && npm run test -w @sonara/web
